origin: NLM Visible Human Male via University of Denver aligned DICOM; independent derivative segmentation by Alavi and Asseln (2026)
coordinate_frame: UNVERIFIED; STL is unitless; do not infer anatomical left/right, scanner-to-HGPT transform or millimetres without source registration
known_limitations: Single 180 cm male is not the HGPT target 182 cm population mean or an independent cohort
Segmentation is partly model-assisted and reviewer judgment has no reported inter-rater statistics
Acquisition truncates elbow; distal humerus and proximal radius/ulna incomplete
Phalanges are combined by digit; not 206 independently segmented bones
Sternum, skull, sacrum/coccyx are grouped; hyoid and costal cartilage missing
No accepted HGPT bone contacts, centroids, joint centres, frames or articulation clearance follows from STLs
Not independent of existing HGPT NLM Visible Human CT patient; independent annotations do not constitute independent subject evidence
